text.text_excerpt: I got a flyer under my door at the LaQuinta Inn from Kubi's Bar and Cafe. I decided to look them up on Yelp and they had good reviews. I started to order lunch to be delivered. Instead I decided to venture out. I headed toward Harrah's Casino and I was looking for somewhere to get a salad. Well.... I came across Kubi's Bar and Cafe. I decided to head on in. I came in and I was immediately greeted by Casey. She was very friendly and welcomed me in. She gave me a menu and I ordered a drink at the bar while I browsed the menu. I picked out my salad and placed my order. I watched Casey work and she handled all the customers with ease. My salad arrived very promptly and it was HUGE! It had hom...

Why is the fried chicken here so damn good? Like... its a bar. Nobody ever has high expectations for bar food. I expect "meh" at the very best.... however, Kubi's decided to whew us with their fried chicken and cocktails. It was so good I caused a bar fight and got kicked out when they refused to give me the recipe. Unfortunately, I am banned from returning to this location but I recommend you go here and be amazed by the party wings. One thing I like about this spot is that it was slightly away from the tourist areas so the people you sit next to are more so locals. The female bartender Alanna was super friendly and knows her way around a good drink!

while staying in the CBD for a locals vacation, we passed through the lobby of our hotel, and found a flyer for this place. looks pretty standard for pizza, pasta, salad, sandwiches, and we discussed ordering. then we saw that they were open for not only delivery, but til FOUR AM... how NICE! so of course, WE HAD TO ORDER. we got the hummus, which was served with a lovely garlic crunchy toasted bread. a lil more bread would've been perfect, but it was so nice.....
